cmd.arch.room_auto.desc: Places a room in every closed boundary of the active level that has none. Open wall loops are skipped, never closed by guess. One undo step.
room_place.placed: Rooms placed: {n}. Regions that already had a room: {m}. Open loops skipped: {k}
room_place.all_had: Nothing placed: all {m} closed regions already have a room. Open loops skipped: {k}
room_place.none: Nothing placed: the level has no closed wall regions
room_place.none_open: Nothing placed: the level has no closed wall regions. Open loops skipped: {k}
